versions.summary: First version: date separation, objectives and roles, incumbents and method comparisons, search budgets and stopping, verification, resources, governance and the adoption preflight (change log §8).

Minor: report-only tail severity (p95, worst-10% mean DD), candidate consideration kept apart from qualification, participation attribution by stage, and an [S] item on protected investigation of multi-component participation (change log §8). No mandatory rule changed; studies pinned to 1.0.0 keep their pin.

Major: §7.7 [M] reporting format — written analysis, Markdown tables and machine-readable results only; no charts, plots, SVGs, screenshots, images, dashboards, HTML visual reports or PDFs (the user's preference, Priority 5A brief §1). Earlier visuals preserved; studies pinned to 1.0.0 or 1.1.0 keep their pin. No research-method rule changed (change log §8).

Minor: §3.5 [S] convention changes (A frozen incumbent, B direct conversion, C re-optimized selection, with the decomposition) and §4.8 [S] reproducing a registered reference method (pin, stage map, omitted-stage reassignment, proportional scaling, budget equivalence); the companion docs/research/methods/ with NL0 1.0.0 (change log §8). No [M] rule changed; studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pin.

Minor: §1.8 [S] the consequence of the chronological verdict, precommitted before searching (default: no chronological support, not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision; an informed lane's selection has no independent chronological test), and §5.9 [R] chronological exposure disclosure (open-lot share of training net, largest open lot's market-value multiple and give-back, per-lot MAE, D1 hold-window tail stress on a declared reference history, training neighbourhood on the next slice), report-only with no threshold (change log §8). No [M] rule changed; studies pinned to earlier versions keep their pin.
